description: A vulnerability was found in SourceCodester Online Faculty Clearance System 1.0. Affected by this issue is some unknown functionality of the file /update_requirement_status.php. The manipulation of the argument haydi results in sql injection. It is possible to launch the attack remotely. The exploit has been made public and could be used.
